terminal_milestone.detail: Campaign07 finished at 2026-10-18 22:43:33.914425 UTC after 599.512 seconds outer elapsed time (310.520 seconds in the wrapper workload). Bubblewrap rejected 11,069 expanded arguments against its installed 9,000-argument parser cap. The sealed descriptor avoids shell/exec transport limits, but does not bypass this parser limit. The rejection occurred before inner Python, the required positive/denial probe or any fit; the outer missing-result error was secondary. Independent review verified all 16 captured files (6,644,139 bytes), 156 observer samples without known native conflict or process-read errors, owned cleanup, released global/controller/statistical locks, and empty attempts/temp directories. All 68 frozen fit attempts remain unstarted and unconsumed.
